q1.explanationZh: 第一段用“三分之一的人没有安全的饮用水”“每天有800名儿童因水问题死亡”这些数字，说明现在的水问题很严重。

evidence.quote: around one in three people worldwide don’t have safe drinking water near their homes

q2.explanationZh: Kurup 说“They really shocked me”，是震惊；后面又说那是孩子们唯一的水，所以她也很难过。选 Surprised and unhappy。

q3.explanationZh: 第四段说，在阳光的帮助下，这个系统能大大减少水里的细菌，也就是让水在阳光下变得更干净。

evidence.quote: With the help of sunlight, the system can greatly reduce the number of bacteria present in water.

q4.explanationZh: 第五段说她的系统单靠自己不够，有些方法在某些情况下比她的更好，说明她的系统不是在所有情况下都管用。

evidence.quote: Some might work better than hers in some situations.

q5.explanationZh: 第五段最后说，Kurup 希望别人也能想出好办法，就是希望更多人一起来解决水问题。

evidence.quote: The girl expects others to come up with great ideas.

q6.explanationZh: 空格前是 He，句子讲过去发明了第一辆电动汽车，所以 invention 变成动词过去式 invented。

evidence.quote: The invention has won many awards.

q7.explanationZh: when 后面是过去式 ate，所以主句也用过去式，reduce 变成 reduced（减少）。

evidence.quote: the system can greatly reduce the number of bacteria present in water

q8.explanationZh: has 后面接过去分词，win 的过去分词是 won，组成现在完成时。

evidence.quote: The invention has won many awards.

q9.explanationZh: is currently 后面要接动词的 -ing 形式，表示正在进行，所以用 visiting。

evidence.quote: to visit their home country every year

q10.explanationZh: The moment I saw her 说的是过去，主句也用过去式，realise 变成 realised。

evidence.quote: It didn’t take long for the girl to realise how different it was

q11.explanationZh: 修饰 ideas（想法）要用 interesting，意思是“有趣的”；interested 用来形容人。
q11.tipsZh: interesting 形容事物，interested 形容人

evidence.quote: There should be many other solutions.

q12.explanationZh: 前半句是否定句，反意疑问句后半部分要用肯定形式。don't 对应 do，主语 people 用 they 代替。

evidence.quote: around one in three people worldwide don’t have safe drinking water near their homes

q13.explanationZh: as a result of 的意思是“由于”，可以换成 because of 或 due to。
q13.tipsZh: because of / due to ＝ as a result of

evidence.quote: 800 children under the age of five die as a result of water problems

q14.explanationZh: become interested in 可以换成 show an interest in。这里是过去的事，所以用 showed。
q14.tipsZh: show an interest in ＝ become interested in

evidence.quote: the girl became interested in science at a young age

q15.explanationZh: 先找谓语：were solved（被解决）是被动语态。可以把 with the help of 放在开头：With the help of the water purification system, the water problems were solved；也可以放在句尾。
q15.tipsZh: with the help of ... 意思是“在……的帮助下”
